disposition_reason: Review of cadmium transfer from soil to cacao beans and chocolate; all concentration tables quote other studies, and the meta-analysis presents pooled data only as figures.

study.design: narrative review with meta-analysis of 785 paired soil-plant data points from seven Latin American surveys (six published, one unpublished)
study.method: literature compilation; no new food analyses
study.qa: quality criteria for study inclusion described in Supplementary Information (not in file)

controls.control: testa (shell) removal from bean to cacao liquor
controls.outcome: complete testa removal can reduce Cd by a factor of about 1.16 from intact bean to liquor (calculated by the authors from tissue partitioning)

controls.control: product type (Cd partitions into non-fat cacao solids)
controls.outcome: Cd negligible in white chocolate and higher in fat-reduced cacao powder (quoted from Mounicou 2003, Kruszewski 2018); no new numbers

mixing low-Cd West African with high-Cd Latin American cacao proposed as the most feasible short-term strategy; nib Cd up to 0.86 mg/kg acceptable for 35% milk chocolate and 1.14 mg/kg for 70% dark chocolate under EU limits (author calculation)

controls.control: soil amendment with lime or biochar
controls.outcome: potential to lower bean Cd in acid soils (review conclusion; effects quoted from other studies)

regulatory_or_exposure.what: EU Cd maximum levels for chocolate and cacao powder (Reg. 488/2014)
regulatory_or_exposure.value: 0.10-0.80 mg/kg depending on cacao solids; 0.30 mg/kg for 30-50% cacao milk chocolate; 0.80 mg/kg for >=50% chocolate

regulatory_or_exposure.what: common industry threshold for cacao bean export to the EU

unresolved: Review: bean, tissue and product Cd values (Tables 1 and 4) are quoted from other studies and are not findings.
The one unpublished dataset in the meta-analysis is pooled with published data in Figures 1-2 (figure-only); no per-sample food values printed.
PDF is the Journal Pre-proof (accepted manuscript with cover page), not the version of record; Supplementary Tables S1-S2 not in the file.
